title: rbac v2: enforce KMS region residency + audit logging enhancements
author: Aisha Shah
release_notes: Enforce KMS region residency for RBAC v2-protected resources; add structured audit logs for KMS access events; rollout gated behind feature flag.
description:
Context and motivation: Customers in regulated regions asked for tight enforcement that key usage for specific resources remains in-region and that every KMS access is auditable. This PR extends RBAC v2 policy enforcement to include KMS region residency constraints and enhances audit logging for KMS-related events so security teams can prove residency and access provenance.

What this changes (high level): - Add new RBAC v2 policy predicate `kms_region_residency` and enforcement hooks in the policy evaluator. - Emit structured audit events for KMS operations (Encrypt/Decrypt/Sign/Verify/GenerateDataKey) including resource_id, key_arn, requested_region, effective_region, policy_decision, and request_trace_id. - Integrate KMS residency checks into the config system and expose a migration path from the previous KMS residency feature flag. - Add permission mapping updates so Dedicated/Private install flows pick up residency constraints. - Add unit and integration tests plus policy fixtures and a migration utility.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-4210) - [x] Policy schema bump + backwards compatible parsing - [x] Unit tests for policy evaluator - [x] Integration tests against simulator KMS - [x] Console flags and rollout gating - [x] Docs draft for compliance teams

Rollout plan: Behind feature flag `rbac_v2_kms_residency` with gradual rollout to 10% account cohort; monitor audit sink and error rates; automatic rollback if enforcement errors exceed threshold. Migration: existing resources without residency metadata will default to permissive behavior until customer opts in via the console or API.

Notes: The description intentionally keeps the enforcement off by default to avoid unexpected failures for customers without residency metadata. The audit logs are enabled when the feature flag is on and will be forwarded to the existing audit sink with a new `kms_residency` event type.
